sentence: I get up at seven every morning
explanation: 'Get up' significa levantarse de la cama. Con 'I', se usa la forma base 'get', no 'gets'.

sentence: Please sit down on the chair
explanation: 'Sit down' significa sentarse. 'Please' lo convierte en una petición cortés.

sentence: She turns on the light every night
explanation: 'Turn on' significa encender un aparato. Con 'she', se agrega -s: 'turns on'.

sentence: He puts on his jacket before going out
hint: Subject + phrasal verb + object + time clause
explanation: 'Put on' significa ponerse ropa. 'Go out' significa salir. Con 'he', se usa 'puts'.

sentence: Please come in before you sit down
explanation: 'Come in' significa entrar. 'Sit down' significa sentarse. 'Before' establece el orden de las acciones.

sentence: I always wake up early on Monday
explanation: 'Wake up' significa dejar de dormir. Los adverbios de frecuencia van antes del verbo principal.

sentence: Can you turn off the television please
explanation: 'Turn off' es lo opuesto de 'turn on'. Las preguntas con 'can' comienzan con el verbo modal.

sentence: The children go out to play after school
hint: 'Children' is plural — use the base form
explanation: 'Go out' significa salir de un lugar. 'Children' es plural, así que se usa 'go', no 'goes'.

sentence: She always picks up the phone very quickly
explanation: 'Pick up' significa levantar algo o contestar el teléfono. Con 'she', se usa 'picks up'. Los adverbios de frecuencia van antes del verbo principal.

sentence: We look for our keys every morning
explanation: 'Look for' significa buscar. Con 'we', se usa la forma base 'look'.

sentence: Please stand up when the teacher enters
He takes off his shoes before entering the house
hint: Subject + phrasal verb + object + time clause

sentence: She puts away her toys every evening
hint: Subject + phrasal verb + object + time expression
explanation: 'Put away' significa guardar algo en su lugar.

sentence: They come back home at six o'clock
hint: Subject + phrasal verb + object + time expression
explanation: 'Come back' significa regresar a un lugar.

sentence: We go back to school in September
explanation: 'Go back' significa volver a un lugar o actividad.
